title: Derived objects and compatible morphisms glue across elementary distinguished squares
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof must glue derived objects from a Zariski open and an etale neighbourhood that need not be an open subspace. It builds a derived fibre triangle, then uses support on the closed complement and conservativity of etale pushforward there to prove the second restriction isomorphism and the compatible-map statement.
